title: Verniman Pivot Statistics — ES · Years, months and recent sessions
summary: Repository-only descriptive ES pivot research with saved cohort filters. Historical pivot availability is unverified; price paths and excursions are not net trading returns.

sections.title: Years, months and recent sessions
sections.body:
Requested ES calendar: 2020-01-01–2026-10-30. This release uses only repository-retained pivots and exact-contract OHLCV; retained market data ends 2026-09-18. The actual eligible dates and coverage limits are saved in the source run.

Repository-retained ES data only; requested coverage ends 2026-10-30, while retained market data ends 2026-09-18. Missing dates/contracts and retrospective full-day eligibility limit generalization.

Historical pivot available_at remains unverified. Nominal 09:25 timing does not establish a historically executable pre-open signal.

Returned-without-EMA and eventual confirmation labels are known later. Already-aligned EMA6 is distinct from an actual new line crossing.

Signed displacement and excursions describe price paths. No entries, fills, costs or net profitability are tested. Broad slices are exploratory.

sections.title: Calendar support and recent windows
sections.body: Years and calendar months use session dates; month-of-year pools the same named month across years. Recent windows are the last 20/60/120 eligible observed sessions at the requested 2026-10-30 cutoff, with actual latest usable date saved in each source row. They do not imply market data exists through that requested date. Empty calendar periods are no sample. These panels are descriptive stability checks, not independent replications.

sections.title: All crosses · 30-minute price outcomes
sections.description: Saved descriptive summaries. Filters select existing rows; counts, denominators and estimates are never recomputed in the browser.
notes: Sparse means fewer than 30 supporting distinct days. Null means unavailable; zero is observed zero. Periods and event panels overlap and cannot be added.
Market sections in New York time: opening_range = 09:30–10:30; new_york_am = 10:30–12:30; new_york_pm = 12:30–16:00. All combines the three sections.

Overall daily means and overall 30-minute outcome mean/positive shares use 2,000 non-circular moving-block replicates of five observed sessions, seed 20261031. Whole-day records preserve repeated-event dependence. No multiple-testing or source-selection correction is implied. Negative and inconclusive cells are retained.

downloads.label: Years, months and recent sessions · selected saved summaries
downloads.description: Exact saved summary strings from this report's first table, across its saved filter choices; no raw event or market-price ledger.
downloads.population: Selected retrospectively eligible ES days and events using the source-quoted delivery contract. Repeated-event panels and calendar windows overlap.
downloads.units: ES points for distance/return fields; rate/share columns are ratios, where 0.42 means 42%. Blank is unavailable; zero is observed zero.
downloads.scope: Selected bounded summaries only. Counts and denominators retain their table-specific meaning; this is not net P&L or an independently verified trading edge.
